text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whooosh... whooosh...)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Huh... About 'friends'...?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I wanted to know the details.
Yeah, I wanted to know more details.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One night, I asked Manhattan Cafe about the presence that weighed heaviest on her mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I remember catching wind of that before as well.
Back then, if I recall...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...A 'friend' who looks just like me...
Someone who guided me... Someone very precious...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...An unchanging figure, ever since I was a child...
The Umamusume who keeps running ahead of me... my... idol..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apparently she met her "friend"
when she was a child. But what does it mean
specifically to "guide" her?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: What... would you like to know?
choice_data_list: What do you mean, you guided me?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
To guide... It means she has always...
"run ahead of me."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not quite it.
It's not just that...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
My "friend" brought me...
to a place of happiness...
Fufufu, fufufufu...♪

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Secretly guiding me
to quiet places nobody knows about..."
Fufufu, fufufufu...♪

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
At the amusement park... she was sitting at the very top
of the Ferris wheel. When I boarded the gondola as if to chase after her... there was such a great view...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I chased my "friend,"
there was always something fun waiting there...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Whenever I wished for it, you always told me where I should go...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No one else... gave me... anything...
Only "Friend" was different.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
There was only one person... who ever made me
have fun... Just one person...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Right now... Yes, I'm sorry.
You might be a bit too close too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Still, meeting you, Trainer, was all thanks to my 'friends' guiding me to Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I understand a little better now. My "friend" isn't simply someone running ahead in a race...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it's like a "pilot to happiness"
for Manhattan Cafe.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Even now, if I wish for it, he will take me anywhere.
For example...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, could you think about this?
"Something you can never obtain in this place."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Things that cannot be obtained here...
Will my "friend" lead me to those kinds of things as well?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The first thing that popped into my head was—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Lavender... is it?
Genus Lavandula, family Lamiaceae...
A flower that does not grow around here..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Still, if you wish from the bottom of your heart...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BAM!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Something shoved my back... with immense force.
Breaking out in a cold sweat, I headed in the direction
I had been driven toward, and there—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
That's a boulder... isn't it?
Shall we move it out of the way together?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Ready, and... Mmh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summoning all the strength in those slender arms to move the rock,
underneath it was—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"It's densely covered in seaweed...
There are tuft-like things at the tip of every single strand..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Are you saying this is meant
to take the place of lavender...?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This might be the best my "friend" can do.
It doesn't seem to be omnipotent, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps she is like a "guardian spirit"
who does everything within her power for me.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Marimo... I see. Spherical algae that inhabit places
like Lake Akan in Hokkaido...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't seem like we'll find it around here, but...
if you wish from the bottom of your heart...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BAM!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Something shoved my back... with immense force.
Breaking out in a cold sweat, I headed in the direction
I had been driven toward, and there—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, we've... walked quite a bit.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer... Look at what's washed up
on the beach here...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was—a clump of algae.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The curled-up remnants of plants
that soaked up massive amounts of polluted water dumped into the sea...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It isn't particularly adorable, but...
Is this supposed to be... a substitute for a marimo?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This might be the best my "friend" can do.
It doesn't seem to be omnipotent, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps she is like a "guardian spirit"
who does everything within her power for me.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Just like this, she guides me
straight toward happiness.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The precious... "friend"...
who has always stayed by my side and helped me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps where Manhattan Cafe is today
is also thanks to this guardian spirit.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: "...Ah, Trainer, look. There's a small island offshore..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I'd like to visit, just a little...
I'm sure... it must be a quiet, beautiful place.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking out across the sea... there really was an island.
But with no bridge or boat, it wasn't a distance
one could just swim across.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I were to truly, seriously
aim for a place like that—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (THUD, THUD, THUD――!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, I felt repeated nudges in my back...!
As if telling me, "Go forth without hesitation!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my "friend" is...
waving at me...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: A voice calling from across the sea, saying, "Over here"...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An existence like a "guardian spirit."
However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I don't know if there is
any desire to protect.
